hints.title: Analyze Move Costs by Parity
hints.text: Moving a chip by two positions costs zero, meaning any chip can change position by any even offset for free.

hints.title: Group by Even and Odd Coordinates
hints.text: All chips at even positions can freely gather at position zero, and all chips at odd positions can gather at position one.

hints.title: Move the Smaller Parity Group
hints.text: The answer is the minimum between the count of chips on even positions and the count on odd positions.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of chips in position array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating every possible target coordinate repeats redundant calculations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting parity takes a single linear sweep and constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should deduce that even moves are free and the problem reduces to parity counts.
complexity.notes: Only the parity of coordinates matters, not their magnitudes.
